category.sound_physics_perfected.own_voi: The volume of your own voice

${id}:config.raysCast.description: # of Rays to cast from players\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: HIGH
${id}:config.raysBounced.description: Max # of times the ray will bounce before terminating\n(More accurate for hearing sounds after bouncing off walls, INCREASING THIS WILL INCREASE REVERB)\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: HIGH
${id}:config.maxRayLength.description: Max Length of a singular ray \nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: MEDIUM
${id}:config.procRange.description: Max distance that SPP will proccess your sound. \n(-1 is infinite range)
${id}:config.tickRate.description:
How often sounds' positions should be updated
(0 is off)
(1 = every tick -> 20 = every second)
PERFORMANCE IMPACT: MEDIUM
${id}:config.soundMult.description: 1 is just default Minecraft sound dist\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: HIGH
${id}:config.volumeMultiplier.description: exactly what it sounds like, you can make sounds louder if u want ig.
${id}:config.reverb.description: Cast Blue (Reverb Detecting) Rays and add reverb dynamically to sources\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: MEDIUM
${id}:config.permeation.description: Cast Red (Permeating) Rays and add muffle dynamically to permeated sources\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: MEDIUM
${id}:config.permeationStepSize.description: Only used when Fast Raytracing is off (or near Sable sub-levels): lower = more precise, but slower\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: HIGH
${id}:config.permeatedTickRate.description:
How often permeated sounds' positions should be updated
(0 is off)
(1 = every tick -> 20 = every second)
PERFORMANCE IMPACT: MEDIUM (higher than normal tickrate)
${id}:config.attenuationType.description: This setting is now largely irrelevant, if you liked the way the mod sounded in the past, this helps. otherwise ignore\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: NONE
${id}:config.rayBounce.description: Larger = less heavily the sound will be coming from walls (will make likely make sounds quieter)\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: NONE
${id}:config.debug.description:
puts sound names in chat.   

CAN CAUSE CRASHES WITH SODIUM 
(idk why, its really weird) 
PERFORMANCE IMPACT: SMALL
${id}:config.maxBlocksPermeated.description: Max blocks permeated in the calculation
${id}:config.permeationAbsorption.description: Volume is multiplied by x^blocksTraveled where x is the value set here for muffle
${id}:config.barrierAsAir.description: Make it so barriers do NOT absorb sound
${id}:config.shortcutDirectionality.description: if direct LOS, use that directionality instead of ray traced \n this removes weird audio panning when having directionality
${id}:config.maxSounds.description: Maximum # of sounds the mod is allowed to process
${id}:config.fastRaytracing.description: Traces rays directly through the block grid instead of using Minecraft's generic ray casting. Same results, several times faster.\nTurns itself off near Sable sub-levels; turn it off if another mod adds geometry that sound should bounce off.\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: FASTER
${id}:config.lowLatencyBudgetMs.description: How long the game may wait each tick for new sounds to finish tracing, so they play on the same tick instead of one tick (50 ms) late.\n0 = never wait\nPERFORMANCE IMPACT: SMALL (only while new sounds play)
${id}:config.airAbsorption.description: Distant sounds lose their high frequencies, like in real air.\n1 = physically accurate, 0 = off
${id}:config.bounceAbsorptionMultiplier.description: how much should be absorbed (1.0 is no absorption, 0.5 is volume reduced by 1/2)
${id}:config.disableFXOnUI.description: Disables FX on Master Category, off by default bc some mods will get ignored if this is on
${id}:config.reverbTuning.description: Shows the reverb the mod computed for your surroundings (decay time, levels, room size).
${id}:config.useExplosionResistance.description: Use Explosion Resistance for how much each block muffles sound\nExplosionFactor / 6, deepslate being the default. Dense blocks that explode easily (dirt, sand, gravel, glass, snow) still muffle at least what their material should.
${id}:config.legacyReverb.description: Switches reverb mode to different versions TUNING IS NOT ALWAYS AVAILABLE
${id}:config.experimentalReverb.description: Enables an experimental reverb which allows reverb to be louder than
${id}:config.globalReverbIntensity.description: Overall reverb level\nHigher = more intense reverb (2 is the default mix)
${id}:config.reverbSmoothing.description: How quickly the reverb follows you into a new space.\nLower = snappier, higher = smoother
${id}:config.decayTimeMultiplier.description: Scales how long reverb tails last. 1 = physically based on the room's size and materials
${id}:config.maxDecayTime.description: Soft limit on reverb tail length, so huge caves stay pleasant.\nShort tails are not affected
${id}:config.reflectionsMultiplier.description: Level of the first echoes off nearby walls
${id}:config.echoMultiplier.description: Strength of distinct echoes off far away cliffs and walls when you are outside
${id}:config.maxOverallGain.description: Maximum overall reverb gain\nPrevents reverb from being too loud
${id}:config.baseHfReference.description: Base high frequency reference (Hz)\nHigher = affects higher frequencies
${id}:config.baseLfReference.description: Base low frequency reference (Hz)\nHigher = affects higher low frequencies
${id}:config.soundBlacklist.description: Does not have to be a full match, will blacklist anything that CONTAINS that name
${id}:config.soundTickBlacklist.description: Does not have to be a full match, will blacklist anything that CONTAINS that name
${id}:config.voicechatReverbSelf.description: Make it so you can hear your own reverb bc Skizzy promised me clout.
${id}:config.voicechatMuffleVolume.description: Makes Volume Lower through walls for Jukeboxes/Players
